paragraphs: Sotaog sells a software subscription for asset-intensive industries, described on its homepage as real time execution SAAS that exposes where operations fail to convert into cash. The about page calls the company an enterprise software solutions provider for the energy and heavy industrials. The platform applies AI and machine learning to forecast interdependencies and predict inefficiencies so that companies can plan proactively.

Data reaches the platform from asset sensors through IIoT, according to the homepage. One named product, SOTA X, is built with machine learning algorithms. The homepage says that product helps heavy industries with predicting and forecasting cashflow. A second product, SOTA 360, is described as covering data acquisition and intuitive visuals.

The homepage says the company works with heavy industries, listing energy, manufacturing, food and beverage, oil and gas, chemical and mining. Buyers are addressed as COOs, with pre-built machine learning models that predict cashflow and deliver recommendations to clients. Pricing is stated as monthly subscriptions rather than billable hours.

quote.text: SOTAOG works with heavy industries like Energy, Manufacturing, Food and Beverage, Oil & Gas, Chemical, Mining and many more.
